scope: 市川市民話の深掘り調査バッチ。人物・寺社・妖怪等の共通主体は親record化せず、各話を個別recordとして扱い、共通主体はタグ／エンティティ参照で横断整理する。

examples: 同一神社に関する複数伝承

deduplication_policy: Each tradition is managed as a single canonical record across the repository. A batch must not retain duplicate full records after canonicalization. Removed duplicates are preserved only as lightweight deduplication history so downstream AI can determine that they were intentionally removed rather than overlooked.
